_comment: Hand-written cue lists, per archetype. These are QUESTIONS, not observed data.
Decision 016: a question cannot fabricate anything, so cueing generously is safe;
the constraint lives entirely on the write step in add-bullet.mjs.
cues.mjs labels everything here `checklist` and reports how many cues came from
here versus from real postings, so a thin duty bank is visible rather than
quietly replaced by guesses. As real postings accumulate for an archetype,
the bank should carry more of the list and this file should matter less.
Scope is deliberately narrow: client-service only. Add an archetype when there
is a reason to, not in anticipation of one.
client-service: handling a customer complaint that escalated past you
a time the point-of-sale or till system failed mid-shift
counting down a till, or reconciling cash at close
opening or closing the store alone
covering a shift or department that was not yours
training someone new, formally or just showing them
a refund or return you had to judge rather than process
a customer who would not leave, or became aggressive
keeping a queue moving when the store was overwhelmed
receiving a delivery, or counting stock against a manifest
a product recall, safety issue, or spill you dealt with
building or changing a staff schedule
flagging theft, loss, or a discrepancy nobody had noticed
a process at the store you changed or suggested changing
serving a customer in a second language
the busiest day of the year, and what your job became that day
